2025_138_nov_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card report for November 2024 went to the Board of Education with the January 21, 2025 agenda. It is a line-by-line listing of every district PCARD charge and credit posted under the journal-entry description "NOV 2024 PCARD EXP", covering transaction dates from 10/28/2024 through 11/25/2024, with each row showing merchant, budget unit, account code, transaction amount, and credits. The listing runs 39 pages footed 1/15/2025 and closes with a subtotal of $333,571.03 in charges and $6,352.51 in credits, producing Total Expenses of $327,218.52.
2025_138_nov_2024_pcard_report.page:
**What it is**
A monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) activity report for Troy School District covering November 2024, presented with the Board of Education agenda for the January 21, 2025 meeting. Each page carries the banner "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, Nov 2024" and the footer date 1/15/2025; the listing runs 39 pages.

**Format**
Six columns: Transaction Description (posting date plus truncated merchant name), JE Description (uniformly "NOV 2024 PCARD EXP"), Budget Unit (15-digit account string), A/C Code (four-digit object code), Transaction Amount, and Credits. Transaction dates run from 10/28/2024 through 11/25/2024.

**Spending patterns**
The overwhelming majority of lines are small classroom and building purchases charged to account code 5110 (Amazon in its several merchant variants, Staples, School Specialty, Blick Art, Shar Music, J.W. Pepper, Lakeshore, Follett, Capstone, Demco). Student-activity and trust budget units beginning 700 and 701 carry account code 5000 and include field trips, class events, and club purchases such as Detroit Zoo ($849.00), The Henry Ford ($1,272.00), Impression 5 ($680.00), PB *Cranbrook ($1,135.00 and $100.00), Emagine Rochester ($994.00), SP Westview ($1,002.00 and $122.25), and SQ *Upland Hills ($891.00).

**Travel and conference (3210/3220)**

Association charges include MASB ($396.00, $594.00, $99.00), Oakland Schools ($45.00 × 3 and $90.00), National Council registrations ($1,500.00, $550.00, $529.00, $62.95, $50.00), TESOL International ($725.00, $800.00, $725.00, $395.00, $105.00), IIRP ($1,011.24), and MSBO ($115.00).
